title: Node API Forge Configuration
description: Shared project configuration for Node API Forge.

frameworks.description: Framework hints for discovery. Provide one or multiple values for mixed projects. Use ["auto"] to auto-detect and cache by project.

customSeedLoaderModulePath.description: Path to a JS module that exports loadSeedManifestEndpoints(projectRoot, context). Relative to the workspace root unless absolute.

autoRefreshOnFileChanges.description: Automatically refresh discovery when relevant source files change.

contextProperties.description: Shared context sub-properties to track on inferred request/response objects.

searchComponentLibAllowlist.description: Library package names that Flow Search may traverse as part of endpoint component-tree expansion.

package.description: npm package name as it appears in import/require strings.

client.description: Short display name shown in the External Calls tab.

apiExplorerFrameworkPageSize.description: Maximum endpoints to render per API Explorer framework page when a framework has many endpoints.
